instrument: Indianapolis Metropolitan Development Commission data center moratorium
summary: The MDC approved a moratorium 6-0 through December 31 2027. Three approved projects proceed (Decatur Township, Martindale-Brightwood, former Ford Visteon on Fintail Drive). The Department of Metropolitan Development will retain a consultant and seat an Advisory Committee to draft standards.
notes: Framework-shaped opening: consultant plus advisory committee. Indiana context per IU Environmental Resilience Institute: 11 counties with ordinances, at least 17 moratoria, 2 bans (Marshall, Cass).
